records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net revenue increased by $12.1 million, or 4.0%, during the three months ended April 2, 2022 compared to the same period a year ago.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: NSE has experienced some impact to customer demand.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: They also support more profitable, higher-performing networks and help speed time-to-revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin decreased by 0.8 percentage points during the three months ended April 2, 2022 from 60.0% in the same period a year ago to 59.2% in the current period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the nine months ended April 2, 2022, Cash provided by operating activities was $104.5 million, consisting of net loss of $1.0 million adjusted for non-cash charges (e.g., loss on convertible note settlement, depreciation, amortization, stock-based compensation and other non-cash items) which totaled $192.1 million, including changes in deferred tax balances, and changes in operating assets and liabilities that used $86.6 million.
